subject: Fix module harness structurally and compare all module gradients
body: ACK HARNESS_HOLD. This is not a backend result. Minimal rerun fix: wrap each Qwen3_5GatedDeltaNet under a model-like path that apply_qwen35_acceleration actually discovers (e.g. model.layers[0].linear_attn), preserve the same weights/inputs/seed/thresholds/backends, and rerun the exact gate. One additional requirement before treating module parity as passed: compare every parameter gradient present in both modules, not only conv1d/in_proj_qkv/out_proj. Fail closed on missing-gradient asymmetry, nonfinite gradients, or any parameter exceeding the already committed module gradient gates. This catches in_proj_z, in_proj_a, in_proj_b, norm, dt_bias, A_log, and any other trainable module state without adding another GPU experiment. No threshold changes.
